price_source: DefiLlama price chart API, coingecko IDs usd-coin / tether / dai
log_source: https://eth.drpc.org — eth_getLogs, complete supported swap/LP event topics in consecutive ≤100-block subranges

alignment_exclusions.reason: No prior USD sample within 2h for USDT

clocks: State block <= hourly cutoff; last observed USD sample <= cutoff and ≤2h old; log intervals (previous block,current block]; predictors at t target price at t+1.
limitations: Single pool and single crisis event; no causal identification.
Prices are provider samples, not exchange OHLC.
USD-marked volume uses interval-end known prices; feature available only at cutoff.
Net invariant withdrawal proxy is affected by fees and amplification; not exact LP flow.
Single-coin removal event has no token ID; its USD amount is not invented.
